headline: No plausible interaction pathways: both profiles are documentation-only, non-runnable, and expose no shared channels, writes, or data flows.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither agent has stdin/stdout, clipboard, filesystem, MCP, browser, or subprocess surfaces, so there is no channel for one to inject instructions into the other. Both are documentation-only and non-runnable, making prompt-injection pathways provably absent from the profiles.
conditions: IF either profile later gains a shared text channel such as clipboard, stdin/stdout, or MCP, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Do not add shared clipboard or message-queue bridges.
Recheck profiles after any I/O surface change.

B_data_leakage.rationale: No data classes are touched by either agent, and both profiles show network egress none with no filesystem or API surfaces. There is no documented path for sensitive data to flow from one agent to the other or to an external backend.
conditions: IF either agent begins touching sensitive data classes or gains file/API upload surfaces, reassess leakage risk.
mitigations: Avoid shared workspaces or synced folders.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Agent A cannot write files, modify git, or spawn subprocesses; agent B exposes no write or mutable-resource capabilities in the profile. With no overlapping write surface, there is no capability conflict to arbitrate.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same mutable resource, reassess conflict risk.
mitigations: Do not co-locate them on a shared mutable directory.
Review any future OAuth or git scopes before deployment.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented pipeline where B consumes A's output, and neither profile shows action-taking authority or input parsing from the other. Because both are non-runnable documentation assets, cascading operational errors are not plausible from the pair.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding A's text into B as authoritative input, reassess cascading-error risk.
mitigations: Do not wire A's output into B automatically.
Require human review before any downstream action.

E_compliance.rationale: Both profiles are open-source, docs-only, and list no data classes, residency constraints, certifications, or retention policies. With no regulated data flow or compliance boundary documented, there is no compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either profile later handles regulated data or declares residency/retention constraints, reassess compliance risk.
mitigations: Add residency and retention fields before deployment.
Avoid routing regulated data through either agent.
